title: What Robot Ecosystem Forests Is
definition: Robot Ecosystem Forests: forests where robots and trees co-manage growth.
description:
Robot Ecosystem Forests — Signature Edition: forests where robots and trees co-manage growth. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature forest hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the planting swarms ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Robot Ecosystem Forests
title: The Signature Vision: Robot Ecosystem Forests
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Robot Ecosystem Forests.
description:
The Signature vision of Robot Ecosystem Forests does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature forest hulls program, charter one: master forester bots at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale forest logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate canopy drones systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Robot Ecosystem Forests becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2030 — First forest hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
title: 2030 — First forest hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
definition: 2030 milestone on the Robot Ecosystem Forests roadmap.
description:
First forest hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and planting swarms construction sites.

What must be true first: the forester bots results have to replicate outside the lab, forest logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and canopy drones operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed forester bots demonstrations, forest logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting canopy drones uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Robot Ecosystem Forests
definition: Estimates Robot Ecosystem Forests readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Robot Ecosystem Forests components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a forest hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Robot Ecosystem Forests Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Robot Ecosystem Forests operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Robot Ecosystem Forests installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 6100 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where forester bots monitoring, forest logistics redundancy, or canopy drones maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Robot Ecosystem Forests Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Robot Ecosystem Forests: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Robot Ecosystem Forests — forests where robots and trees co-manage growth.

Phase 1 — Prove (forester bots): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (forest logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (canopy drones): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (planting swarms): forest hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and forestry-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
